entries.msgstr: The Assembly Shop is open again!
We are starting to work on the next project. We will let you know when we finish development. See you soon!
Delivery of vehicles with numbers complete. We are starting to assemble the %(vehicle)s in a standard configuration. Hurry—the number of vehicles is limited!
Assembly of vehicles complete. All vehicles delivered to their owners.

Delivery of %(soldOutVehicle)s complete. You still have the opportunity to purchase %(availableVehicle)s. If you have spent resources but do not complete the purchase in time, they will be returned to your account soon. Hurry—the number of vehicles is limited!
Assembly of vehicles complete. All vehicles delivered to their owners. All spent resources will be returned to your account soon.
Commander, you have a chance to become the owner of the %(vehicle)s with a numbered 3D style. The number of vehicles is limited!
The Assembly Shop is temporarily unavailable due to maintenance.
The unique %(vehicle)s received from the Assembly Shop.
The %(vehicle)s received from the Assembly Shop.
Commander, this is your chance to get your hands on the %(firstVehicle)s and %(secondVehicle)s! But be quick—stocks are limited!
